opening.argument: The video traces money across historical periods, moving from a goat marked 10,000 BC to a coin marked 1839 before presenting cryptocurrency as part of changing financial systems. Its Coinbase branding and website indicate company promotion and informational outreach, but they do not turn that historical overview into a deceptive transaction. The material promises no return, requires no payment, and requests no credentials. The description also expressly disclaims investment advice. On the evidence presented, there is no specific deceptive participation mechanism.

citations.quote: Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
